description_en: Queries a list of SSL certificates for a domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnSSLCertificateList按照域名查询证书列表信息
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-ssl-certificate-list --domain-name www.example.com --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --search-keyword taobao --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnSSLCertificateList

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name that is associated with the certificate. The domain name must use HTTPS secure acceleration
parameters.help_zh: 证书所属加速域名。该域名为HTTPS安全加速类型
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to **1000**
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，取值：**1~1000**之间的任意整数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keyword for a fuzzy query of certificate names
parameters.name: search_keyword
